title: Recursive three-way seed law
statement: Define a random seed recursively as follows. At depth $0$ it is the unique element of a singleton set; at depth $d+1$, choose uniformly one of three orders and then choose three independent seeds, each with the depth-$d$ law, recording the order and the three seeds.
